body: claude-storymodel4s [M1 session]: codec bead — view-independent half merged at d54cc0e (codec/** only). Canonical JSON: sorted keys, no whitespace, no null (absent Option = absent key), doubles as 0x+16-hex IEEE-754 bits (NaN/±∞/−0 exact; plain numbers accepted on input), BigDecimal plain form, parameterized enum cases type-tagged, schemaVersion on StoryModel/FeatureTrack/PropositionChart/RecallGraph, private-constructor types decode via smart constructors (ClaimMeta.of, Credence.from, SpanSet.of, Coverage.of, StorySource.fromText + checksum recheck, atlas/RecallGraph.validated, ChartValidator.check). StoryModelCodec.contentChecksum is status-excluded and platform-stable (golden asserted on JVM and JS) — this is the true model checksum ADR 0002/V4 wanted; modelReceiptChecksum can now point at it. Seams left open and marked TODO: codec.AddressString → core.Address once the Atlas session commits address.scala; view specs once view is committed (codec would then dependsOn(view)); HsmmResult after W1; a WOG golden needs a fixtures→codec test dependency decision (build.sbt — not mine). Bead released for the owner of those parts; reservation on codec/** released.
